title: Proverbs Chapter 22 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Proverbs chapter 22 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Proverbs Chapter 22 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Proverbs Chapter 22.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 22:1, what is to be chosen rather than great riches?
questions.correctAnswer: A good name
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:1 states that 'A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches'.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 22:2 say about the rich and poor?
options: The rich always oppress the poor
questions.correctAnswer: They meet together
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:2 says 'The rich and poor meet together: the LORD is the maker of them all.'

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 22:3 teaches that a prudent man foresees evil and hides himself.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:3 states 'A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself'.

questions.question: What are the benefits that come by humility and the fear of the LORD according to Proverbs 22:4?
questions.correctAnswer: Riches, honour, and life
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:4 says 'By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.'

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 22:5 warns that thorns and snares are in the way of the froward.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:5 states 'Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward'.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 22:6, what will happen if a child is trained up in the way he should go?
options: He will not depart from it when he is old
questions.correctAnswer: He will not depart from it when he is old
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:6 states 'Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.'

questions.question: Who rules over the poor according to Proverbs 22:7?
questions.correctAnswer: The rich
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:7 says 'The rich ruleth over the poor'.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 22:8 teaches that he who sows iniquity will reap vanity.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:8 says 'He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity'.

questions.question: What blessing does a person receive for giving of his bread to the poor according to Proverbs 22:9?
questions.correctAnswer: He shall be blessed
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:9 states 'He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.'

questions.question: What is the result of casting out the scorner according to Proverbs 22:10?
questions.correctAnswer: Contention and strife shall cease
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:10 says 'Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.'

questions.question: In Proverbs 22, which instruction comes before all the others listed here?
options: Train up a child in the way he should go
The rich ruleth over the poor
A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches
Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out
questions.correctAnswer: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:1 appears before the others and says 'A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches.'

questions.question: According to Proverbs 22:11, who shall be the friend of the king?
options: He that loveth pureness of heart
questions.correctAnswer: He that loveth pureness of heart
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:11 states 'He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.'

questions.question: Who preserves knowledge and overthrows the words of the transgressor according to Proverbs 22:12?
questions.correctAnswer: The eyes of the LORD
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:12 says 'The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.'

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 22:13 describes the slothful man as being brave and facing lions in the streets.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:13 describes the slothful man as saying 'There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets,' showing fear, not bravery.

questions.question: What is the mouth of strange women likened to in Proverbs 22:14?
questions.correctAnswer: A deep pit
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:14 says 'The mouth of strange women is a deep pit'.

medium.title: Proverbs Chapter 22 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Proverbs Chapter 22 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 22:11, what benefit does loving pureness of heart and having grace in one's lips bring?
options: The king shall be his friend
He shall live a long life
questions.correctAnswer: The king shall be his friend
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:11 states that he who loves pureness of heart and has grace in his lips will find friendship with the king, highlighting the value of integrity and gracious speech in gaining favor.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 22:12 say about the eyes of the LORD?
options: They preserve knowledge and overthrow the words of the transgressor
questions.correctAnswer: They preserve knowledge and overthrow the words of the transgressor
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:12 teaches that the LORD's eyes preserve knowledge and bring down the words of those who transgress, emphasizing God's awareness and justice.

questions.question: What reason does the slothful man give for not going outside, according to Proverbs 22:13?
options: There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets
It is too hot to work
He is waiting for others to help
questions.correctAnswer: There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:13 shows the slothful man's excuse as fear of a lion outside, symbolizing irrational avoidance of responsibility.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 22:14, what is the danger associated with the mouth of strange women?
options: It is a deep pit that causes one to fall
questions.correctAnswer: It is a deep pit that causes one to fall
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:14 warns that the mouth of strange women is like a deep pit, causing those abhorred by the LORD to fall into it, illustrating the peril of immoral enticement.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 22:15 say is bound in the heart of a child, and how can it be removed?
options: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; the rod of correction drives it far away
Joy is bound in the heart of a child; prayer drives it far away
Fear is bound in the heart of a child; teaching drives it far away
Greed is bound in the heart of a child; discipline drives it far away
questions.correctAnswer: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; the rod of correction drives it far away
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:15 highlights that foolishness is naturally in a child's heart but can be removed through the rod of correction, emphasizing the importance of discipline.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 22:16 explain the consequences of oppressing the poor to increase riches?
options: He shall surely come to want
He will live a long life
He will gain honor among men
questions.correctAnswer: He shall surely come to want
questions.explanation: According to Proverbs 22:16, oppressing the poor to gain riches leads to eventual want, teaching that unjust gain results in loss.

questions.question: What practical instruction does Proverbs 22:17 give concerning the words of the wise?
options: Bow down thine ear, and hear, and apply thy heart unto knowledge
Ignore the words of the wise
Speak loudly the words of the wise
Write the words of the wise on stone
questions.correctAnswer: Bow down thine ear, and hear, and apply thy heart unto knowledge
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:17 instructs to listen attentively and apply the heart to knowledge, emphasizing the value of humble learning and obedience.

questions.question: What is said in Proverbs 22:18 about keeping the words of wisdom within oneself?
options: It is pleasant and they shall be fitted in thy lips
questions.correctAnswer: It is pleasant and they shall be fitted in thy lips
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:18 teaches that keeping wise words within oneself is pleasant and prepares one to speak them appropriately, highlighting internalizing wisdom.

questions.question: What is the relationship between Proverbs 22:19 and trusting in the LORD?
options: The knowledge made known today is so that thy trust may be in the LORD
Trusting in the LORD is unnecessary
Trust in wealth is better than the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: The knowledge made known today is so that thy trust may be in the LORD
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:19 explains that the teachings revealed are intended to establish trust in the LORD, linking knowledge to faith and reliance on God.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 22:20, what has been written to the reader?
options: Excellent things in counsels and knowledge
questions.correctAnswer: Excellent things in counsels and knowledge
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:20 states that excellent things involving counsels and knowledge have been written, providing wise guidance for living.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 22:11 and 22:12 together teach about the impact of the heart's purity and God's oversight?
options: A pure heart and gracious speech gain favor with the king, while the LORD preserves knowledge and judges transgressors
Pure hearts are ignored; only wealth matters
God overlooks transgressors who speak well
The king judges the transgressors, not God
questions.correctAnswer: A pure heart and gracious speech gain favor with the king, while the LORD preserves knowledge and judges transgressors
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:11 shows that purity and gracious speech lead to royal favor, and 22:12 reveals God's preservation of knowledge and judgment of wrongdoers, emphasizing integrity before both man and God.

questions.question: What promise does Proverbs 22:18 give if one keeps the wise words within themselves as instructed in Proverbs 22:17?
options: The words will be fitted in their lips and will be pleasant
They will become proud and boastful
They will be rejected by others
questions.correctAnswer: The words will be fitted in their lips and will be pleasant
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:17 instructs to listen and apply knowledge, and 22:18 promises that keeping these words within is pleasant and prepares one to speak them rightly.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 22:13 teaches that the slothful man bravely faces dangers outside his home.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:13 describes the slothful man as fearful and making excuses about dangers like a lion outside, showing avoidance rather than bravery.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 22:15 suggests that discipline can remove foolishness from a child's heart.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:15 clearly states that foolishness is bound in a child's heart but the rod of correction drives it far away, affirming the value of discipline.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 22:16 teaches that generosity toward the poor always leads to poverty.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:16 warns against oppressing the poor to increase riches and giving to the rich to come to want, not generosity to the poor; generosity is blessed elsewhere in the chapter.

hard.title: Proverbs Chapter 22 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Proverbs Chapter 22.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 22:21, what is the purpose of making known the certainty of the words of truth?
options: To answer the words of truth to those who send to you
questions.correctAnswer: To answer the words of truth to those who send to you
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:21 states that the knowledge of the certainty of the words of truth is given so that you might answer the words of truth to those that send unto you.

questions.question: What instruction is given concerning the poor in Proverbs 22:22?
options: Rob not the poor, because he is poor
Ignore the poor to avoid trouble
Oppress the afflicted in the gate
questions.correctAnswer: Rob not the poor, because he is poor
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:22 directly commands not to rob the poor because of their poverty, emphasizing justice and compassion.

questions.question: What consequence does Proverbs 22:23 describe for those who oppress the poor?
options: The LORD will plead their cause and spoil the soul of those who spoiled them
They will be honored by the king
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD will plead their cause and spoil the soul of those who spoiled them
questions.explanation: This verse warns that God will defend the poor and bring ruin upon those who oppress them, highlighting divine justice.

questions.question: What caution does Proverbs 22:24 give regarding relationships?
options: Make no friendship with an angry man
questions.correctAnswer: Make no friendship with an angry man
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:24 advises avoiding close associations with angry or furious individuals to prevent adopting their harmful ways.

questions.question: Why should one not make friendship with an angry man, according to Proverbs 22:25?
options: Lest you learn his ways and get a snare to your soul
Because it will make you poor
Because it will cause you to sin openly
Because it will lead to exile
questions.correctAnswer: Lest you learn his ways and get a snare to your soul
questions.explanation: The verse warns that associating with angry people can lead one to adopt their behavior, resulting in spiritual harm.

questions.question: What advice does Proverbs 22:26 give about financial commitments?
options: Be not one of those who strike hands or are sureties for debts
questions.correctAnswer: Be not one of those who strike hands or are sureties for debts
questions.explanation: This verse cautions against becoming surety or guarantor for debts, to avoid financial entanglement and loss.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 22:27, what question is posed about debt and possessions?
options: If you have nothing to pay, why should your bed be taken away?
Why should the lender be generous?
Is it wise to lend to friends?
questions.correctAnswer: If you have nothing to pay, why should your bed be taken away?
questions.explanation: The verse questions the fairness of losing possessions when one cannot pay debts, emphasizing caution in financial obligations.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 22:28 instruct regarding ancient landmarks?
options: Remove not the ancient landmark which your fathers have set
Build new landmarks for your land
questions.correctAnswer: Remove not the ancient landmark which your fathers have set
questions.explanation: This verse commands respect for ancestral boundaries, reflecting the importance of justice and tradition in land ownership.

questions.question: What reward is promised in Proverbs 22:29 for a man diligent in his business?
options: He shall stand before kings and not before mean men
He will be honored among his peers
questions.correctAnswer: He shall stand before kings and not before mean men
questions.explanation: The verse promises that diligence in one’s work leads to honor and recognition by rulers rather than common people.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage echoes the theme of defending the poor found in Proverbs 22:22-23?
questions.correctAnswer: Psalm 82:3-4
questions.explanation: Psalm 82:3-4 similarly commands to defend the poor and fatherless, aligning with Proverbs' emphasis on justice for the oppressed.

questions.question: The Hebrew word translated as 'snare' in Proverbs 22:25 carries what connotation?
options: A trap or entanglement causing harm
questions.correctAnswer: A trap or entanglement causing harm
questions.explanation: The Hebrew term 'mokat' means a trap or snare, symbolizing a danger or entanglement that ensnares the soul as per Proverbs 22:25.

questions.question: Which literary device is prominently used in Proverbs 22:24-25 to warn against associating with angry men?
questions.correctAnswer: Cause and effect
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:24-25 employs cause and effect to show that friendship with angry men causes one to learn their ways and fall into a snare.

questions.question: How does the teaching of Proverbs 22:29 about diligent men relate to Jesus' teaching in the New Testament?
options: It parallels Luke 16:10 about faithfulness in little leading to greater responsibilities
It contradicts Jesus' emphasis on humility
It is unrelated to any New Testament teaching
It emphasizes wealth as the ultimate reward
questions.correctAnswer: It parallels Luke 16:10 about faithfulness in little leading to greater responsibilities
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:29’s praise for diligence parallels Luke 16:10, where faithfulness in little leads to greater trust, showing continuity in wisdom teaching.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 22:26-27 advise believers to avoid becoming guarantors for debts to prevent financial loss.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:26-27 warn against striking hands or being surety for debts to avoid losing possessions, making this statement true.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 22:28 encourages removing ancient landmarks to expand one’s inheritance.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:28 commands not to remove ancient landmarks, emphasizing respect for ancestral boundaries; thus, the statement is false.

theological.title: Proverbs Chapter 22 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Proverbs Chapter 22 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 22:1 teach about the value of a good name?
options: It is more valuable than great riches
It is less valuable than silver
It is only important for the rich
questions.correctAnswer: It is more valuable than great riches
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:1 states that 'A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches,' emphasizing the intrinsic value of one's reputation over material wealth.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 22:2, who is the maker of both the rich and the poor?
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:2 highlights that 'the LORD is the maker of them all,' indicating God's sovereignty over all humanity regardless of their social status.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 22:3 suggest a prudent man does?
options: He foresees evil and hides himself
questions.correctAnswer: He foresees evil and hides himself
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:3 states that 'A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself,' illustrating the wisdom of anticipating danger and taking precautions.

questions.question: What principle regarding humility is found in Proverbs 22:4?
options: It brings riches, honour, and life
questions.correctAnswer: It brings riches, honour, and life
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:4 teaches that 'By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life,' showing that humility is linked to divine blessings.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 22:6, what is the outcome of training a child correctly?
options: They will not depart from the right path
questions.correctAnswer: They will not depart from the right path
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:6 emphasizes that 'Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it,' affirming the long-term impact of proper guidance.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 22:8 reveal about the consequences of sowing iniquity?
questions.correctAnswer: It leads to vanity
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:8 states, 'He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity,' warning that wrongdoing ultimately results in emptiness and futility.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 22:10 imply about dealing with scorners?
questions.correctAnswer: They should be cast out
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:10 advises, 'Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out,' suggesting that removing those who mock will lead to peace.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 22:13 indicate about the slothful man's attitude toward danger?
questions.correctAnswer: He makes excuses
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:13 illustrates the slothful man's excuse by saying, 'There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets,' highlighting how laziness leads to irrational fears.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 22:16, what will happen to those who oppress the poor?
options: They will surely come to want
questions.correctAnswer: They will surely come to want
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:16 warns that 'He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches... shall surely come to want,' indicating that exploitation leads to eventual loss.

questions.question: Which attribute of God is demonstrated in Proverbs 22:12 regarding knowledge?
questions.correctAnswer: Omniscience
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:12 states, 'The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge,' showcasing God's all-knowing nature in safeguarding wisdom.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that the Bible promotes oppression of the poor. What does Proverbs 22:22-23 actually teach?
options: It commands the rich to oppress the poor
It forbids robbing and oppressing the poor
It ignores the issue of poverty
questions.correctAnswer: It forbids robbing and oppressing the poor
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:22-23 teaches, 'Rob not the poor... neither oppress the afflicted,' indicating that God advocates for the protection of the vulnerable.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 22:19 emphasize about trust in the LORD?
options: It is a sign of weakness
It should be known and proclaimed
questions.correctAnswer: It should be known and proclaimed
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:19 states, 'That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day,' emphasizing the importance of acknowledging and trusting in God.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 22:29 connect diligence to success?
options: Diligence leads to standing before kings
questions.correctAnswer: Diligence leads to standing before kings
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:29 states, 'Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings,' linking hard work with recognition and success.

questions.question: What combined teaching do Proverbs 22:4 and 22:16 convey about wealth and humility?
options: Humility and fear of the LORD yield true wealth
questions.correctAnswer: Humility and fear of the LORD yield true wealth
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:4 and 22:16 together teach that humility and reverence for God lead to genuine riches, while oppression of the poor leads to loss.

questions.question: What insight do Proverbs 22:10 and 22:24 provide regarding relationships?
options: Avoiding angry men leads to peace
Strife is a sign of strength
questions.correctAnswer: Avoiding angry men leads to peace
questions.explanation: Proverbs 22:10 and 22:24 suggest that casting out scorners and avoiding friendships with angry individuals will lead to a more peaceful life.
